The destination, which I opened, is OpenStreetMap's 'Copyright and License' page. So the name does match where the link goes: it names the site, and the © in its own text marks it as the data attribution and licence credit. Understanding 2.4.4 says the link need not use the target document's name. Seen this way the claim is false and the link meets 2.4.4. The screenshot shows the attribution rendered as on a live Mapbox map. My plain fetch cannot run the map script, but the footer data in the live HTML matches the snapshot and nothing points to a different capture. The href was in the HTML the model saw, so this is a judgment error.
